headline: Mooring and Nevish Quicken as Expanse Battle Endures
war_summary: Since the evening wires the fighting has shifted south and west while the north has fallen silent. Callahan's Passage holds at nine Warden to one Colonial with two changes in the last two hours and twenty-one on the day about Crumbling Post, with day losses near 8,300 Colonial and 8,370 Warden and rates again accelerating. The Weathered Expanse now stands one Warden, six Colonial and two unheld with two changes in two hours and fifty-four on the day about Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Spirit Watch, day losses about 9,340 Colonial and 12,870 Warden. Mooring County has quickened with three changes in two hours and five on the day about MacConmara Barrows and Wiccwalk at ten Warden to two Colonial. The Nevish Line counts three changes in two hours and sixteen on the day about Grief Mother at four apiece. Palantine Berm stirs again with two changes in two hours after forty-eight on the day about The Droll, still seven Warden. Kuura Strand, Fisherman's Row, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle report no changes in two hours.
